title: Pre-Registered Experimental Protocol for Selective Anomaly Detection and Human Review Prioritization in Industrial Visual Inspection
target_journals: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (T-PAMI)

hypothesis.primary_statement: In unsupervised one-class industrial visual anomaly detection operating under bounded human review budgets (B <= 20%), selective review prioritization driven by decision-boundary proximity and local patch neighborhood geometry achieves statistically superior Error Capture Rate (ECR) and Defect Escape Reduction (DER) compared to naive score-based triaging or uniform random sampling, without requiring access to defect training samples.
hypothesis.novelty_barrier: Candidate patch-neighborhood dispersion metrics (CPND) must demonstrate statistically significant improvement (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.05, Holm-Bonferroni corrected) over the Distance-to-Threshold baseline (|S(X) - tau_c|) across independent evaluation categories.
hypothesis.theoretical_scope: Split conformal prediction on nominal calibration samples provides finite-sample distribution-free control of the nominal False Positive Rate (FPR <= alpha). Defect capture and review triage effectiveness are empirical ranking properties governed by uncertainty-error concordance, not distribution-free conformal guarantees.

development_and_ablation_benchmarks.name: MVTec Anomaly Detection (MVTec AD)
development_and_ablation_benchmarks.role: Development and ablation benchmark. 100% development-exposed through historical training, architecture selection, and threshold tuning.

development_and_ablation_benchmarks.name: VisA — Capsules Subset
development_and_ablation_benchmarks.role: Development-exposed ablation subset. Quarantined from final unexposed generalization benchmarks due to prior V1 test and V2 development evaluations.

held_out_generalization_benchmarks.name: VisA (Visual Anomaly Dataset — 11 Untouched Categories)
held_out_generalization_benchmarks.exposure_status: POTENTIALLY INDEPENDENT / UNTOUCHED (0 model fitting, 0 feature extraction, 0 threshold calibration, 0 evaluation runs)
held_out_generalization_benchmarks.access_rule: Strictly quarantined until selective review algorithm, hyperparameters, and decision rules are completely frozen.

held_out_generalization_benchmarks.name: BTAD (BeanTech Anomaly Detection — Mishra et al., 2021)
held_out_generalization_benchmarks.exposure_status: POTENTIALLY INDEPENDENT / UNTOUCHED (0 prior executions in DefectVision AI)
held_out_generalization_benchmarks.access_rule: Strictly quarantined until selective review algorithm, hyperparameters, and decision rules are completely frozen.

quarantined_datasets.name: Chukyo Real-World Automotive Dataset
quarantined_datasets.rationale: Quarantined in cold storage due to 14 identical capture pairs and 25 duplicate similarity pairs.

primary.name: Error Capture Rate (ECR@B)
primary.interpretation: Fraction of overall model misclassifications (false negatives + false positives) intercepted and corrected under review budget B.

primary.name: Defect Escape Reduction (DER@B)
primary.interpretation: Fraction of escaped defects recovered by human auditor under budget B.

baselines.name: Uniform Random Selection
baselines.procedure: Samples k = floor(B * N) images uniformly at random without replacement (1,000 Monte Carlo trials)

baselines.name: Highest Anomaly Score
baselines.procedure: Ranks images descending by raw PatchCore anomaly score S(X)

baselines.name: Distance to Category Threshold
baselines.procedure: Prioritizes samples closest to the decision threshold tau_c

baselines.name: Supervised Prediction Margin
baselines.procedure: Ranks by epistemic margin of supervised classifier (requires labeled defect training)

baselines.name: Calibrated Patch-Neighborhood Dispersion (CPND)
baselines.formula: std_k(distances) / mean_k(distances) for top-K FAISS neighbors
baselines.ablation_requirement: Must be evaluated alone and in combination with BL2: u_joint(X) = alpha * u_BL2(X) + (1 - alpha) * u_CPND(X)

calibration_strategy.method: Split Conformal Prediction on Nominal Training/Validation Partitions
calibration_strategy.coverage_guarantee: Under exchangeability of normal test items: P(S(X) <= q_hat | X in Normal) >= 1 - alpha. No distribution-free guarantee on defective items.

statistical_testing.confidence_interval_method: Non-parametric BCa bootstrap (1,000 resamples per category)
statistical_testing.sampling_unit_rationale: In industrial production lines, each arriving item represents an independent inspection event; resampling at the image level captures operational batch variance without assuming Gaussian error distributions.
statistical_testing.significance_test: Two-tailed paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test across independent categories with Holm-Bonferroni correction (alpha = 0.05)

stopping_and_failure_rules.superiority_criterion: CPND demonstrates statistically significant higher mean ECR@10% than BL2 (p < 0.05).
stopping_and_failure_rules.negative_finding_criterion: If CPND fails to beat BL2 (p >= 0.05), report transparently as a negative result demonstrating that scalar decision boundary distance dominates local patch dispersion in nearest-neighbor triage.
stopping_and_failure_rules.no_post_hoc_cherrypicking: Hyperparameters (k, coreset fraction, distance weighting) selected on development data (MVTec AD + VisA capsules) shall not be retuned after observing held-out benchmark results.

computational_budget.hardware_target: Standard x86_64 CPU workstation or Google Colab T4 environment
